CREATE TRIGGER trg_UpdateStockOnOrderCancel
ON Orders
AFTER UPDATE
AS
BEGIN
    -- On vérifie si la colonne OrderStatus a été modifiée
    IF UPDATE(OrderStatus)
    BEGIN
        UPDATE P
        SET P.StockQuantity = P.StockQuantity + Restitution.TotalQuantity
        FROM Products P
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT OI.ProductID, SUM(OI.Quantity) AS TotalQuantity
            FROM OrderItems OI
            INNER JOIN inserted i ON OI.OrderID = i.OrderID
            INNER JOIN deleted d ON i.OrderID = d.OrderID
            WHERE i.OrderStatus = 'Cancelled' AND (d.OrderStatus <> 'Cancelled' OR d.OrderStatus IS NULL)
            GROUP BY OI.ProductID
        ) Restitution ON P.ProductID = Restitution.ProductID;
    END
END;
